anyFormatDesc: Drop a PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, AVIF, or HEIC image and convert it to any supported output. You don't need to match the current page.
tooManyConversions: Too many conversions. Please wait a moment.
steps_jpg-to-webp_1Desc: Select a JPEG to convert to WebP. WebP typically reduces file size by 30-50% compared to JPEG while maintaining similar visual quality.
steps_jpg-to-webp_2Desc: Adjust the quality slider — WebP achieves excellent results at lower quality settings compared to JPEG. The default 80% typically looks great.
steps_jpg-to-webp_3Desc: Click Convert to produce a WebP file optimized for web performance. Smaller file sizes mean faster page loads while preserving image quality.
